scores.evidence: Paged and aggregated paths exist for the main lists; class pages, fee generation and dashboard aggregates still load whole tables (lib/classes.js:181, lib/fees.js:436, lib/fees.js:1340).
scores.rationale: Recent refactors fixed the highest-traffic lists, but several screens and bulk paths remain O(whole school). No measurement was possible.
scores.gaps: No load test, EXPLAIN or bundle build; production pooler config unknown.

scores.evidence: No pool configuration in lib/db.js; bulk import, promotion and fee generation are per-row sequential work; cron serves one school.
scores.rationale: Fine for a handful of schools; connection limits, per-request auth queries and unbounded bulk paths will bind first at 10x/100x.
scores.gaps: Production DB topology, Vercel plan limits and real data volumes not inspected.

scores.evidence: No import cycles in 703 files and lib never imports UI, but lib/api.js is 2,181 lines and helpers are duplicated (formatCurrency in 19 files).
scores.rationale: Layering is sound; cycle avoidance relies on comments and file splits, and duplication is widespread.
scores.gaps: No complexity metrics or test coverage; only structure was reviewed.

findings.title: Class/section pages and student list load the entire school roster including JSON blobs
findings.evidence: lib/students.js:207-210; lib/classes.js:181,219,232,318,335; app/dashboard/students/list/page.jsx:15; app/api/students/route.js:35 - unfiltered findMany of all sessions with all Json columns
findings.impact: Per-view cost grows with all students of all sessions; at 10x thousands of wide rows per class screen
findings.recommendation: groupBy class/section counts for list views; filtered select findMany for section detail; keep getAllStudents for exports only

findings.title: Fee generation loads whole roster and issues one create per student in one array transaction
findings.evidence: lib/fees.js:436-439,445-452,477-503; app/api/cron/generate-fees/route.js - no createMany, no batching, no maxDuration
findings.impact: Long single transaction with large IN list; one failure rolls back all and returns 500
findings.recommendation: Query with where filter and narrow select, chunk, createMany skipDuplicates, export maxDuration on cron

findings.title: Dashboard attendance trend scans every attendance row ever stored for the school
findings.evidence: lib/attendance.js:387-396 jsonb_array_elements over all rows, no date or session bound; app/dashboard/page.jsx:113 per render
findings.impact: Cost grows with years of history on every dashboard visit; JSON cannot be indexed
findings.recommendation: Bound default to current session or 12 months, or maintain a daily summary table, or cache with tag invalidation on save

findings.title: No connection-pool configuration in code or schema; fan-out patterns can exhaust a serverless pool
findings.evidence: lib/db.js:3-7 PrismaClient with no options; schema.prisma:18-21 url only, no directUrl; fan-out at app/api/students/bulk-import/route.js:20, lib/dashboard.js:98-110
findings.impact: P1001/P2024 or max_connections errors under concurrent load if production URL is not pooled; production config not verified
findings.recommendation: Use provider transaction pooler with connection_limit, add directUrl for migrations, bound Promise.all concurrency, document topology

findings.title: Bulk student import: full roster read, sequential inserts, unbounded parallel fee generation, no row cap
findings.evidence: app/api/students/bulk-import/route.js:14-20; lib/students.js:552-560
findings.impact: Large sheets likely exceed serverless duration and saturate the pool, leaving partial imports
findings.recommendation: Cap rows per request, duplicate check via IN query, bounded concurrency or createMany for fees

findings.title: Promotion/retention does 3 sequential queries per student inside a default-timeout interactive transaction
findings.evidence: lib/students.js:767-805 and applyEnrollment lib/students.js:101-119; no transaction timeout option anywhere in lib
findings.impact: Large promotions can time out and roll back, blocking year-end processing
findings.recommendation: createMany for enrollments and logs after one lookup, explicit timeout, UI chunking

findings.title: Whole-school aggregates computed in JavaScript (fees dashboard, exam dashboard)
findings.component: Admin dashboard fee cards, exams dashboard
findings.evidence: lib/fees.js:1340-1356 loads every StudentFee with items and student; lib/exams.js:354-357 loads every ExamSchedule and ExamMark row
findings.impact: Dashboard cost scales with all fee rows and all marks ever created; ExamMark grows fastest
findings.recommendation: groupBy/count for exams; push stable sums to SQL and compute late fee only for overdue unpaid fees in active session

findings.title: Every protected request re-loads user + role + all permissions uncached; polling multiplies it
findings.evidence: lib/rbac.js:91-95,113-116; lib/iam.js:18; 129 call sites, one React cache() in repo (lib/fees.js:1340); components/dashboard/NotificationBell.jsx:53 polls every 60s
findings.impact: Constant per-request DB overhead growing with concurrent users; query counts not measured
findings.recommendation: React cache() around actor loaders; cache role permission sets with tag invalidation

findings.title: Attendance reports pull JSON records for the whole range and scan in JS
findings.evidence: lib/attendance.js:178-188 and callers at 273,297,332,361,472,519
findings.impact: Range reports download whole records JSON; per-student history cannot use an index
findings.recommendation: Narrow select, bound ranges, consider row-per-student table after benchmarking

findings.title: Heavy libraries statically imported into client components; no next/dynamic anywhere
findings.component: Dashboard chart modals, bulk import modals, address forms
findings.evidence: components/dashboard/ClasswiseAttendanceModal.jsx:3-4 (and 4 other chart files); components/students/BulkImportModal.jsx:4; components/performance/TestMarksEntry.jsx:5; lib/location.js:1; no dynamic() in app/components/lib
findings.impact: Larger first-load JS for pages that only open these on demand; size not measured (build forbidden)
findings.recommendation: dynamic import with ssr:false for chart and import modals; lazy-load country-state-city

findings.title: pageSize uncapped on payments and schools list routes; remaining unbounded list endpoints
findings.evidence: app/api/payments/route.js:21; app/api/schools/route.js:16 - Number(pageSize)||20 with no upper clamp, page not clamped to >=1
findings.impact: One authenticated request can read an entire table
findings.recommendation: Apply the clamp used at app/api/homework/page/route.js:24; clamp page >= 1

findings.title: Notice/exam notification fan-out is O(recipients) in memory on the request process and unawaited
findings.evidence: lib/notices.js:399-407,473-478; lib/parentNotifications.js:22-35; fire-and-forget
findings.impact: Large schools: heavy memory/DB burst and possible loss of notifications when serverless freezes after response
findings.recommendation: Use after()/waitUntil per installed Next docs or await bounded counts; chunk createMany; bound concurrency

findings.title: Support unread count loads every ticket row; calendar tag invalidates all tenants
findings.evidence: lib/support.js:85-95; lib/calendarEvents.js:38-47,92,101,110
findings.impact: Minor overhead and cross-tenant cache churn; no data leak (schoolId is part of cache key)
findings.recommendation: count with where; per-school cache tags

findings.title: Fee and payment relationship: denormalised paidAmount with unconstrained Payment links
findings.impact: Ledger total can diverge from payment rows after races; no DB invariant detects it
findings.recommendation: Guarded atomic increment, CHECK constraints, FK indexes, reconciliation job

findings.title: Student delete cascade policy is inconsistent across child tables
findings.impact: Results and enrollment history deleted for students with no fee rows; dangling ids left in attendance JSON
findings.recommendation: Archive instead of delete; Restrict on results and promotion log (see DB-005)

findings.title: Login identities are not unique across tenants (Teacher has no unique email)
findings.evidence: schema.prisma:678 (Teacher), ParentAccount and User unique per school only; see DB-003
findings.impact: Wrong-tenant login or lockout when two schools reuse an address
findings.recommendation: Resolve per DB-003

findings.title: Class, section and subject are plain strings in most tables; names drift from master data
findings.component: Student, Attendance, Homework, ExamSchedule, TimeTable, Teacher.assignments
findings.evidence: schema.prisma:366-368,869-870,959-961,1121-1123,809-811,661,753; local DB (demo seed): 18 Homeworks with subject matching no Subject row, 3 Attendance rows with no matching class+section
findings.impact: Rename or delete cannot cascade; history keeps old text; orphans appear as blank values and are silently excluded by equality filters
findings.recommendation: Block rename/delete with dependants and validate on write; longer term add nullable id FKs and backfill

findings.title: Student placement has two sources of truth (strings on Student and StudentEnrollment FKs)
findings.evidence: lib/students.js:774-805; lib/fees.js:436-439; lib/students.js:906-928
findings.impact: Silent divergence if one write path updates only one; reports by session may disagree (none observed locally)
findings.recommendation: Single write function for placement; periodic consistency query

findings.title: No tenant off-boarding path: every School FK is Restrict, children mixed
findings.evidence: schema.prisma School relations default Restrict (about 40 models); no school delete route identified in app/api/schools
findings.impact: No defined export/purge for contract end or erasure requests
findings.recommendation: Document and build an ordered offboarding job; keep Restrict

findings.title: Duplicated helpers and business rules across lib and components
findings.evidence: formatCurrency local function in 19 files e.g. components/dashboard/PendingFeesCard.jsx:5; toLocalDateStr defined at lib/dateUtils.js:8, lib/homework.js:10, components/students/StudentAttendanceTab.jsx:16, app/api/attendance/report/route.js:8; teacher scope in lib/roleGuard.js:47-77 vs components/homework/HomeworkFormModal.jsx:57
findings.impact: Rule changes must be repeated in several places; drift risk (local-time dates, DB-006)
findings.recommendation: Single formatters module and dateUtils import; one scope function used by client filters

findings.title: Module structure: god modules and cycle avoided only by file-splitting and comments
findings.evidence: Import graph of 703 files: 0 static cycles; comments at lib/students.js:436-445, lib/feeConstants.js:7 record the splits; lib/api.js 2,181 lines/190 exports imported by 119 files; no server-only guards
findings.impact: Risk of accidentally bundling server modules into client code and of refactor friction, not a runtime loop
findings.recommendation: Add server-only to Prisma/next-headers modules (check installed Next docs), split lib/api.js by domain

notAssessed: Production database pooling and Vercel limits - no access to hosting configuration
Runtime performance - no load test, EXPLAIN or build permitted/run
Bundle size - next build forbidden; import-level analysis only
Orphan counts in production data - local demo DB only
